description: "Documentation of the AMCR-PAS API, through which museum systems and field applications create finds in AMCR-PAS, update their registration numbers and add photographs."
---

The [AMCR-PAS API reference](/pas-api/index.qmd) documents the write interface
available to external integrators, including museum systems and offline field
applications. MUSEION is the reference client.

The section covers vocabulary mapping through the existing OAI-PMH sets,
authentication, the XML import contract, registration-number updates,
photograph uploads, configurable schema acceptance, rate limits and record
locks. cURL and Python examples show authenticated import and update requests.

This entry records a documentation addition; it does not announce a new API
deployment or a MUSEION release.
